newsitem.title: UK: Oxford Biomedica sees flotation in early December.
newsitem.headline: Oxford Biomedica sees flotation in early December.

text.p: Oxford Biomedica Plc, a gene therapy company which has grown out of research at Oxford University, said on Monday that it expected its shares to start trading on the Alerntative Investment Market (AIM) in the first week of December.
In its pathfinder prospectus, Oxford Biomedica said it expected to raise around five million stg through the share offer to fund its research and help set up a new headquarters.
Publication of the full details of the flotation, including the offer price, is expected in the third week of November.

The company has a number of gene patents acquired from Oxford University and has filed four other patent applications. It believes that it may hold the key to transforming a whole range of conditions, including cancer, HIV and Parkinson's Disease.
The company said it aimed to take its first drug into Phase I and II clinical trials within three years.
